title: F3 - data/axes/vocabulary.json
description: The declared behaviour axes, their variants and their occupancy over the 525-entry live registry.

efh.spec: FOUNDATION.md 2.7 lines 336-338 ('unchanged from D1 2.3 except: modal_share stays ... and occupancy: 0 is published'), resolving to D1-reference-structure.md 2.3 lines 187-209
efh.propertyOrderNote: Order is D1 2.3's table order, which FOUNDATION 2.7 adopts by reference. The generated organ at HEAD emits six extra fields (declared_kind, backing_field, default_value, unset_occupancy, extraction, oxfunc_tree_clean) and omits the table's required consumer_sites, documenting the omission in its own `extraction.fields_not_emitted`. That divergence is reported by efh-validate check, not absorbed here.
efh.keyOrderContract: Emit keys in propertyOrder exactly; axes[] is ordinal-sorted by key.

catalog_size.description: R. 525 at OxFunc 473efa3, from the live registry length. D1 2.3 line 193. Note this is the registry catalog, NOT the 541-entry Handbook denominator (SD-1).

key.description: R. snake_case key as it appears in F1.

documented_in_source.description: R. false for 7 of 13 axes. Forces gloss_basis: handbook-inferred on every F4 variant of those axes (FOUNDATION 2.7 lines 344-345).

consumer_sites.description: R per D1 2.3 line 201: non-test read sites; an empty array is a fact worth publishing (thread_safety has none). NOT EMITTED by the generator at HEAD, which states in extraction.fields_not_emitted that a textual grep is a different fact and 'would be published under a name that overstates it, so it is omitted rather than approximated'. The schema keeps the field required because FOUNDATION 2.7 adopts D1 2.3 unchanged on this point; efh-validate check reports the divergence.

occupancy.description: R. 0 IS PUBLISHED for NotThreadSafe, PairwiseTree, KahanCompensated, ProducesErrorMetadata (FOUNDATION 2.7 line 338).

modal_share.description: R. Occupancy of the modal variant / catalog_size. FOUNDATION 2.7 line 337: modal_share STAYS, because the chip-suppression rule reads it at build time - A3-S8 moved chip_suppression out of F4 and made it derived from this field, oxfunc_tier and the vacuity rule.
